findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.citation_text:
4-501.114(A) Manual and Mechanical Warewashing Equipment, Chemical Sanitization - Temperature, pH, Concentration, and Hardness. A chemical SANITIZER used in a SANITIZING solution for a manual or mechanical operation at contact times specified under 4-703.11(C) shall meet the criteria specified under §7-204.11.

On arrival the sani buckets in the facility were observed to barely register a color change on the inspector’s test strips. The PIC was shown and had the buckets remade to correct. Ensure that all sanitizers in use in the facility are maintained at effective concentration at all times.

findings.title: Proper cold holding temperatures.
findings.citation_text:
3-501.16(A)(2) Time/Temperature Control for Safety Food, Hot and Cold Holding. (A) Except during preparation, cooking, or cooling, or when time is used as the public health control as specified under §3-501.19, and except as specified under (B) and in (C) of this section, TIME/TEMPERATURE CONTROL FOR SAFETY FOOD shall be maintained:(2) At 5°C (41°F) or less. 

Pre-cooked eggs, ham and breakfast sauce were observed with internal temperatures of 48F-53F in the floor based reach in cooler next to the grills. The items were discarded to correct the immediate violation. Refer to line item #33 for the cooler follow-up. Ensure that all TCS foods are held at safe temperatures at all times so as to prevent foodborne illnesses.

findings.title: Proper cooling methods used; adequate equipment for temperature control.
findings.citation_text:
4-301.11 Cooling, Heating, and Holding Capacities. EQUIPMENT for cooling and heating FOOD, and holding cold and hot FOOD, shall be sufficient in number and capacity to provide FOOD temperatures as specified under Chapter 3. 

The floor based reach in cooler next to the grills was observed holding TCS foods at 48F-53F internal temperatures on both the inspector’s and facility’s thermometers. The cooler needs repaired and a follow up is being scheduled to verify that the situation is resolved.

findings.title: Single use/single service articles are properly stored and used.
findings.citation_text:
4-903.11(C) Equipment, Utensils, Linens, and Single-Service and Single-Use Articles. (C) SINGLE-SERVICE and SINGLE-USE ARTICLES shall be stored as specified under (A) of this section and shall be kept in the original protective PACKAGE or stored by using other means that afford protection from contamination until used.

Several stacks of to-go containers were observed with the food contact surfaces up/exposed. The PIC was shown and instructed to store them so that the food contact surfaces are protected (flipped face down). The stacks were flipped over to correct. Ensure that all single service items are stored so that they are protected at all times.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean.
findings.citation_text:
4-601.11(C) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (C) NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris.

1) The unused cooler next to the grill was observed with remaining food debris. This location was out of service but should have been cleaned when it was taken out of service to prevent possible pest concerns. 2) The cooler under the coffee machine that stores in-use milk bags had a large accumulation of milk spill observed. Both locations were shown to the PIC and they were instructed to clean and maintained clean moving forward. Ensure that all non-food contact surfaces are maintained clean at all times int he facility.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean.
findings.comment:
Observed the following areas to have food debris/splash accumulation:
1) Fry freezer to be soiled with fry debris.
2) Cooler under table observed to soiled with food debris accumulation. 
3) Red meat freezer observed soiled with food debris accumulation. 
4) The top of ice cream machine observed soiled with ice cream splash accumulation. 

Discussed with PIC, areas will be cleaned. Ensure facility is cleaning non food contact surfaces at a frequency that prevents food debris/splash accumulation.
